sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: flying (her move loop): she flies forward leaning in, never touching the ground, her legs trailing bent behind her, her WINGS BEATING, the sword held low behind her in her far hand, her hair streaming back
sheets.weapons: THE SWORD goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): held in her FAR hand (image right) by its gold hilt, the cyan flame blade pointing where the pale figure's does - low down to the right unless she swings, raises or thrusts it. Only ONE sword, the design's. Both WINGS as the pale figure: spread, raised or swept back.
sheets.wings: Frame 1: wings swept back level. Frame 2: wings swept back and down. She FLIES the whole loop: no foot ever touches the ground, the legs trailing bent behind her as the pale figure; the body bobs up and down with the beats. Follow the pale figure's WINGS exactly - never the same wing pose in every frame.
